name: Iqra Fund
mission: Iqra Fund provides preschool programs for communities to teach children ages four to six years old basic language, social, and formal learning skills to help them succeed in primary school.

strengths_deep_dive: Iqra Fund demonstrates high spending efficiency by directing <cite id="7">87.0% of total expenses to program activities in FY2024</cite>. This exceeds the sector benchmark of 75%. Independent assessment agencies reflect this commitment to operational integrity, as the organization earned a <cite id="1">100/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. Additionally, the organization maintains a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid, confirming public disclosure of its governance policies and programmatic metrics.
rich_narrative.summary: Iqra Fund focuses on expanding educational access for young children in remote regions of Pakistan. Founded in 2011, the charity helps children build fundamental early learning and social skills through local preschool and primary education programs <cite id="1">Charity Navigator - Ratings</cite>. <cite id="7">In FY2024, the organization reported $1,029,954 in total revenue</cite>, maintaining a focused financial model dedicated to rural education. <cite id="7">The organization maintained an 87.0% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, which beats the 75% industry standard benchmark. Iqra Fund maintains strong third-party transparency standings, holds <cite id="1">a 100/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, and holds a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid. <cite id="2">The charity accepts zakat donations</cite> to support educational opportunities for underserved children in Muslim-majority rural communities.
